jobs.title: Director, Product Management (Discovery, Search, Personalization)
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

PRODUCT MANAGEMENT

What We Do

Product Management partners with game development, publishing, marketing, and platform teams to provide a data and market-driven view of product strategy that aligns with business goals. As part of Epic’s Growth Team, we use our product expertise to identify and drive growth levers to grow our player base and business.

What You'll Do

As a Director of Product Management, you will be a key leader within the Discovery product org. You will help define the strategy and flywheel of the Discovery system, working closely with Development, Design, and Data Science teams to ship features and optimize systems that connect players with the right content at the right time. You will translate high-level strategic goals into actionable roadmaps, write detailed requirements, and drive cross-functional execution. You will partner with marketing, content strategy, and creator initiatives teams to ensure their needs are reflected in the product.

In this role, you will

- Own product strategy and execution for defined areas of the Discover surface, developing roadmaps that improve player discovery and drive growth

- Write detailed business and product requirements that guide design and technical specifications, partnering directly with Development and Data Science to ship high-quality systems and features

- Develop and refine "playbooks" and operational strategies that leverage Discover features to achieve initiative goals, using data to measure effectiveness and iterate

- Build and present product and feature concepts to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, clearly articulating impact, rationale, and expected outcomes

- Drive live operations execution for Discover initiatives, ensuring consistent quality and identifying opportunities for improvement through data analysis

What we're looking for

- 5+ years of Product Management experience, with meaningful exposure to discovery systems, content platforms, recommendation engines, or large-scale consumer products

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to use data to inform product decisions, define success metrics, and evaluate feature performance

- Passion for games and a solid understanding of growth, retention, and monetization mechanics that deliver value for players

- Interest in creator ecosystems, with the ability to understand and advocate for developers building on a platform

- Track record of shipping products in fast-paced, highly collaborative environments with multiple stakeholders

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience writing product requirement documents and presenting to senior leadership

- Experience managing or mentoring other PMs is a plus

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

Our intent is to cover all things that are medically necessary and improve the quality of life. We pay 100% of the premiums for both you and your dependents. Our coverage includes Medical, Dental, a Vision HRA, Long Term Disability, Life Insurance & a 401k with competitive match. We also offer a robust mental well-being program through Modern Health, which provides free therapy and coaching for employees & dependents. Throughout the year we celebrate our employees with events and company-wide paid breaks. We offer unlimited PTO and sick time and recognize individuals for 7 years of employment with a paid sabbatical.
ABOUT US

Epic Games​ ​is a leading interactive entertainment company. For over 30 years we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Learn more about our Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy here .

Note to Recruitment Agencies: Epic does not accept any unsolicited resumes or approaches from any unauthorized third party (including recruitment or placement agencies) (i.e., a third party with whom we do not have a negotiated and validly executed agreement). We will not pay any fees to any unauthorized third party. Further details on these matters can be found here .

jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

TRUST AND SAFETY

What We Do

The Epic Trust and Safety team provides a safer experience for Epic users. We work across multiple products and services to improve technology and craft transparent policies so our players and users can have positive experiences on our platforms.

What You'll Do

FamXP, the Family Experience team within Trust, Safety, and Support, is responsible for the safety, privacy, and age-appropriate experience of kids and families across Epic's products. We ship features for kids and parents, review product updates across the company for safety and privacy considerations, collaborate with legal to translate regulatory requirements to an actionable product roadmap, and provide insights to our partner teams grounded in primary research we conduct with parents and players. This Product Management Director role will own complex, cross-product initiatives on the FamXP roadmap, set priorities for the FamXP team, and set the standard for how the FamXP product team operates.

In this role, you will

- Drive FamXP initiatives from strategy through design, build, and launch, in partnership with engineering, QA, design, legal, policy, and analytics counterparts across multiple Epic product surfaces

- Keep priorities clear, dependencies visible, and teams moving on what matters most

- Develop and communicate FamXP strategy to the executive audience

- Define metrics that matter, strengthen instrumentation where the signal is weak, and guide the team to ground decisions in data

- Navigate a fast-evolving global regulatory landscape, partnering closely with legal and policy to translate new obligations into product deliverables (often on tight timelines)

What we're looking for

- 6+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning complex, cross-product, or platform initiatives

- Direct, hands-on experience partnering with legal, regulatory, or compliance teams, ideally in a regulated industry

- Structured thinker who can bring clarity and momentum to an ambiguous problem space

- Strong written and verbal communicator, comfortable representing strategy and trade-offs to executive stakeholders

- Quantitative thinker who drives visibility into product performance and pushes to improve signal when it's lacking

- User-first mindset: you frame every problem within the user's needs and experience.

- Strong technical foundation and a track record of learning new technologies fast

- Collaborative team member who builds trust through transparency, accountability, and follow-through

- Adaptable and resilient in an environment where priorities evolve quickly

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

Our intent is to cover all things that are medically necessary and improve the quality of life. We pay 100% of the premiums for both you and your dependents. Our coverage includes Medical, Dental, a Vision HRA, Long Term Disability, Life Insurance & a 401k with competitive match. We also offer a robust mental well-being program through Modern Health, which provides free therapy and coaching for employees & dependents. Throughout the year we celebrate our employees with events and company-wide paid breaks. We offer unlimited PTO and sick time and recognize individuals for 7 years of employment with a paid sabbatical.

- Drive the mobile, PC and console product strategy and contribute to a roadmap that expands reach, engagement, and long-term retention on each platform

- Partner with development teams to identify and prioritize feature opportunities, gameplay enhancements, and system improvements that elevate the player experience on each platform

- Work with cross-functional partners to optimize player funnels, in-game experiences, and market readiness across regions

- Partner with engineering teams to prioritize features and enhancements that improve performance and player experience across backend and frontend systems

- Partner closely with analytics teams to define measurable goals, evaluate performance, and ensure recommendations are grounded in clear data and business impact

- Drive alignment across key stakeholders by clearly communicating product requirements, ensuring all stakeholders share a unified understanding of goals and execution plans

What we're looking for

- 6+ years of Product Management experience building and scaling consumer-facing platform products or shared systems across multiple surfaces (e.g., mobile, PC, console)

- Proven track record delivering platform features that power core player experiences such as identity, progression, social systems, or cross-platform continuity

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to leverage data to improve platform adoption, engagement, and overall user experience

- Highly skilled at translating user needs and business goals into scalable, cohesive platform solutions that work seamlessly across devices

- Experience partnering closely with engineering on complex systems and balancing usability, performance, and scalability in platform design

- Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in fast-paced, cross-functional environments with engineering, design, and business stakeholders

- Familiarity with cross-platform ecosystems (PC, console, mobile) and the challenges of delivering consistent, high-quality user experiences across them

- Understanding of player experience drivers such as onboarding, engagement, retention, and ecosystem connectivity—applied at a platform level rather than individual game features

- Passion for building foundational player experiences that connect users across games, devices, and services

- Define measurable goals for major roadmap initiatives, track business impact across releases, and use those insights to continuously refine prioritization

- Stay deeply connected to the UEFN creator and UE developer community, translating their needs and behaviors into ecosystem strategy alongside the creator success team

- Define and grow pathways for developers to participate in the broader epic ecosystem and metaverse economy, shaping new commercial models and open standards

- Lead and grow a team of product managers, providing mentorship, organizational clarity, and the structure needed to execute a complex, multi-workstream roadmap effectively

- Collaborate across Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing, and cross-functional partners to align on priorities, requirements, and go-to-market execution for major platform releases

- 12+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time spent on developer tools, game engines, or complex platform ecosystems

- Deep understanding of the game development process and the needs of creators and developers building on real-time 3D platforms

- Proven ability to function as a business partner to engineering leadership someone who can bring goal-setting, prioritization frameworks, and growth thinking to a team that builds the platform others build on

- Experience defining and tracking product KPIs, measuring roadmap impact, and using data to drive decisions

- Strong understanding of platform ecosystem dynamics such as social features, marketplace integrations, developer services, and how they compound into long-term growth

- Exceptional communication skills with the ability to align diverse stakeholders, write clear product requirements, and present strategy to senior leadership

- Experience managing and developing high-performing product managers across multiple concurrent workstreams

- A genuine passion for the creator and developer community; someone who stays close to how developers and players are evolving and can translate that into a compelling product vision

TECHNICAL PRODUCT MANAGEMENT INTERN

What You'll Do

We are building the Discover Publish Tool to help our creators and partners manage and publish their content. As a Technical Product Management Intern, you will help define and ship improvements to this tooling and get hands-on experience taking a product idea from problem definition through delivery. You'll work closely with engineers, the product lead, and the operators who use the tool every day to understand problems, write clear requirements, make scope tradeoffs, and test what gets built. Along the way, you'll learn from an experienced product manager and gain hands-on experience with the tools, processes, and practices used to build high-quality products. By the end of the internship, you'll have shipped a real product improvement that our partners use.

In this role, you will

- Define scoped product improvements for Discover by writing clear requirements, user flows, and acceptance criteria with guidance from the product lead

- Take a scoped product improvement from problem definition through build, testing, and delivery, with support from an experienced product mentor

- Talk to the operators and partners who use our solutions to understand their workflows and turn pain points into actionable requirements

- Use data such as usage metrics, dashboards, and spreadsheet or SQL analysis to size problems, inform prioritization, and measure whether shipped features work

- Test features before release, give structured feedback to engineers, and help coordinate and communicate releases to stakeholders

- Learn and apply team product practices, tools, and processes

What we're looking for

- Currently enrolled in, or recently graduated from, a degree program in Business, Management Information Systems, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

- Demonstrated technical aptitude: comfort working with data (spreadsheets, SQL, or similar), a working understanding of how web applications, APIs, and databases fit together, and the curiosity to get hands-on with new technical tools (light coding or scripting experience is a plus, not a requirement)

- Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to turn ambiguous problems into clear, structured documents

- Foundational problem-solving skills, with an ability to learn quickly and work collaboratively

- Interest in owning problems end to end and building high-quality tools and user experiences for creators and partners

- Ability to receive and incorporate feedback and work effectively with guidance from experienced team members
